arguments.explanation: Flags transactions whose amount is negative and below -$300, which is the refund pattern you described.
assumptions: Amounts are in cents, so -$300 is -30000 and the condition is amount_usd_cents < -30000 (strictly below -$300).
The data does not document what negative amounts mean. The rule treats them as refunds because you described them that way, not because the data confirms it.
The rule uses no other conditions (no transaction type, card type or merchant filter).
